mathematical_meanings: Left image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right end of the horizontal axis on the red stair-step plot). Right image: x names the horizontal coordinate axis (the right arrow on the axis passing through A and B).
Rationales: In both images, x names the horizontal coordinate axis. The relevant locations are the right end of the horizontal axis on the red stair-step plot on the left and the right arrow on the axis passing through A and B on the right.
